{{Top|leg}}
The '''Borleias New Republic base''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] up until the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base that had watched over the nearby [[Alderaan Biotics facility]]. A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Domain Kraal base|base]] was eventually built over its remains.
